Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.clients

Class JdbcClientRegistrationRepository

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.clients.JdbcClientRegistrationRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientRegistrationRepository
@Repository public class JdbcClientRegistrationRepository extends Object implements ClientRegistrationRepository
ClientRegistrationRepository over Spring Authorization Server's RegisteredClientRepository (the JDBC one), which reads and writes the oauth2_registered_client table. The operations that repository does not offer (listing, deleting, replacing a secret) run directly on that table. The conversion between both models belongs to the RegisteredClientMapper.

    • deleteByClientId

      public void deleteByClientId(String clientId)

      The authorizations (with their consumed refresh tokens, by cascade) and the consents granted to the client reference it by its internal id without a foreign key, so they are deleted first, in the same transaction: otherwise loading one of them later fails because its client is gone. The transaction is the caller's: use cases demarcate transactions, never the adapters.

      Specified by:
      deleteByClientId in interface ClientRegistrationRepository
